answer_1.quote: We develop computational methods to provide feedback using insights from the formative study and collected dataset ... We propose a new prompting strategy ... Our method improves the accuracy in skill use evaluation, outperforming GPT-4 ...
datasets: Expert annotated DEAR MAN skill use dataset
answer_1.outputs: Simulated conversation utterances, skill‑use ratings, and improvement‑suggestion text

answer_2.quote: We also conduct a secondary evaluation using automatic metrics, ROUGE-L and BertScore, and report macro F1 scores for skill‑rating classification.

answer_3.quote: We also use a simple GPT-4‑based few‑shot prompting method to measure specificity and actionability of the improvement suggestions.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation with 13 CS PhD students who are familiar with LM generations. The participants are guided by a rubric and asked to judge whether model‑generated feedback is the same as expert feedback.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators use a rubric asking if the model feedback would lead them to act the same as the expert feedback, and whether the reasoning matches the expert’s.
